cleaner.label: Claude Code (AI)
cleaner.description: Selective cleanup of cache, prompts, logs, transcripts and checkpoints.

option.label: Temporary cache
option.description: Deletes regenerable caches and stale local images.

option.label: Logs and diagnostics
option.description: Deletes debug logs, telemetry and diagnostic files.

option.label: Prompt history
option.description: Deletes the prompt history and the contents of large pasted texts.
option.warning: You will lose search and recall of earlier prompts.

option.label: Session transcripts
option.description: Deletes the conversation JSONL files in the projects, keeping the Markdown memories.
option.warning: Deleted conversations cannot be resumed. Any metadata and auxiliary files remain. To remove all data consistently, use claude purge.

option.label: Checkpoints and tasks
option.description: Deletes snapshots and plans of earlier sessions.
option.warning: You will lose the ability to restore changes and resume tasks from checkpoints.

option.label: Scratchpads and temporary attachments
option.description: Deletes temporary files and scratchpads in Claude sessions.
option.warning: Scratchpads may contain drafts, images and scripts not yet saved in the project.
